name: sow-signed-to-deal-won

trigger.trigger_note: Catch hook. The Notion SOWs DB automation (Status -> Signed) must POST here; `trigger_url` is Zapier-internal.

notion.note: The SOW page is re-read with sdk.fetch (webhook is a ping); the Deal write uses the Notion update_database_item action. Deal lifecycle: esignatures-send-for-signing sets 'In signing' when the SOW goes out, this workflow sets 'Closed Won' when it is signed.

replaces_classic_zap: SOW Signed -> Mark Deal as Won

cutover.notion_sows_automation_repointed: PENDING — repoint the Notion SOWs DB automation (fires when Status becomes Signed) at this workflow's webhook_url.
cutover.classic_zap_disabled: PENDING — turn the classic Zap off in the Zapier UI once repointed. Not machine-verifiable.
cutover.status: durable live and verified; Notion-side repointing outstanding

description: Notion SOWs automation (SOW signed) -> re-read the SOW and set its related Deal's Status to Closed Won. Skips cleanly on empty pings, archived SOWs, non-SOW pages and SOWs with no Deal relation.
